battle.name: 蘇拉內戰
battle.theater: 羅馬、坎帕尼亞與西班牙戰線
battle.brief: 前83年執政官蘇拉自東方帶六個帝國軍團回師，先在羅馬城北的科利納門擊潰馬里安派，再於同年十月夜襲攻陷羅馬城，戰火隨即轉入坎帕尼亞的龐貝與薩爾諾河，並延伸到西班牙的塞爾托里烏斯戰線。卡面的羅馬標槍正是兩方重裝步兵手中的標準投射武器：槍幹中空，捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍

countries: 蘇拉內戰（前83年至前82年，主戰在意大利本土，西班牙戰線延續到前72年）是羅馬共和國的一次內戰。蘇拉派以執政官盧基烏斯·科爾涅利烏斯·蘇拉為首，核心是他在東方戰線統率並帶回祖國的六個帝國軍團，以及隨軍歸國的元老院派與各城邦派來的依附者。馬里安派以執政官盧基烏斯·科爾涅利烏斯·辛納與蓋約·馬爾基烏斯·肯索里努斯為政治旗手，軍事上依賴蓋約·龐培·斯特拉波在意大利組織的民兵、昆圖斯·塞爾托里烏斯在伊庇里亞與盧西塔尼亞的戰士，以及一批不滿蘇拉清算的舊將。西班牙另成一個戰區：蘇拉派由總督普布利烏斯·科爾涅利烏斯·多拉貝拉與繼任者蓋約·梅米烏斯坐鎮，馬里安派則以塞爾托里烏斯為首自立，雙方在貝提斯河兩岸以及塔拉科納、希斯帕利斯一帶拉鋸。這場戰爭的奇特之處在於兩派都自稱代表國家，骨子裡卻各自以護民官與前任執政官的私黨為骨架；元老院在羅馬城兩度被攻破的過程中化為棋盤，護民官那面憲法上的盾也只剩下名分，被兩方輪流借用。
countriesEn: The Sullan civil war (from 83 to 82 BC, fought mainly in Italy, with the Spanish theatre running on until 72 BC) was a civil war inside the Roman Republic. The Sullan party was headed by the consul Lucius Cornelius Sulla, and its core was the six legions he had commanded in the eastern theatre and carried home with him, together with the senatorial faction that came back with the army and the clients dispatched by the Italian cities. The Marian party raised its political banner under the consuls Lucius Cornelius Cinna and Gaius Marcius Censorinus, and leaned militarily on the levies organised in Italy by Gaius Pompeius Strabo, on Quintus Sertorius's fighters in Iberia and Lusitania, and on a body of former officers who resented Sulla's proscriptions. Spain formed a separate theatre: the Sullan side was held by the governor Publius Cornelius Dolabella and his successor Gaius Memmius, while the Marian side stood on its own under Sertorius, the two sides grinding against each other along the Guadalquivir and around Tarraco and Hispalis. What makes this war strange is that both parties claimed to speak for the state while resting in truth on the private followings of tribunes and former consuls; the senate, battered twice in Rome, was reduced to a piece on the board, and the tribunes' constitutional shield was left with nothing but a name, borrowed in turn by either side.
people: 蘇拉派的核心是執政官盧基烏斯·科爾涅利烏斯·蘇拉。他前84年自對米特里達梯六世的東方戰線回師，用六個軍團迫使元老院與辛納接受和約，前83年當選執政官，任內以軍力主持選舉、清洗元老院，安插大批新成員。他最倚重的部將是盧基烏斯·李錫尼烏斯·盧庫盧斯與昆圖斯·凱基利烏斯·梅特魯斯，前者鎮守亞細亞與希臘，後者接管西班牙戰線；蘇拉派的護民官馬爾庫斯·迪迪烏斯與普布利烏斯·布魯圖斯則在前83年提出土地法案，親手點燃戰火。馬里安派方面，辛納與肯索里努斯在科利納門敗後相繼被自己人殺死，蓋約·龐培·斯特拉波在薩爾諾河戰死；昆圖斯·塞爾托里烏斯是唯一全身而退者，他以三千名馬里安老兵為核心，在盧西塔尼亞重建軍隊，於貝提斯河擊敗梅米烏斯，隨後以元老院自居、頒布法令、鑄造錢幣，維持獨立政權直到前72年被自己人刺殺。希斯帕利斯陷落時，塞爾托里烏斯的妻與子遇害，此事成為他此後行動的深重牽掛。
peopleEn: The centre of the Sullan party was the consul Lucius Cornelius Sulla. Returning from the eastern theatre against Mithridates VI, in 84 BC he used his six legions to force the senate and Cinna to accept a peace; in 83 BC he was elected consul, and governed by running the elections under arms, purging the senate and packing it with new members. His most trusted lieutenants were Lucius Licinius Lucullus and Quintus Caecilius Metellus, the first holding Asia and Greece, the second taking over the Spanish command; the Sullan tribunes Marcus Didius and Publius Brutes brought forward the agrarian bill in 83 BC and lit the war themselves. On the Marian side, Cinna and Censorinus were killed by their own men after the defeat at the Colline Gate, and Gaius Pompeius Strabo fell at the Sarno. Quintus Sertorius was the only one to come out whole: with about three thousand Roman veterans who had served under Marius he rebuilt an army in Lusitania, beat Memmius on the Guadalquivir, then set himself up as a senate, issuing decrees and striking coins, and kept that independent state alive until his own men killed him in 72 BC. His wife and children were killed when Hispalis fell, and the business became a lasting weight on everything he did afterwards.
kits: 卡面的羅馬標槍是這場戰爭裡帝國軍團最標準的投射兵器：木製槍桿前段裝上鐵莖，鐵莖尾端有鉛套配重，全槍約兩公尺，軍士在短兵相接前先擲出一支，射程約二十五至三十公尺。前83年蘇拉軍與馬里安派手中的帝國步兵用的都是這種標槍，它正是馬略改革之後取代舊式長矛、被列為軍團制式投射武器的那一支。標槍的設計重點全在破壞盾牌：鐵莖細而硬，捅穿盾面之後就折斷彎曲並留在盾上，敵兵無法把盾丟下，只好拖著變形的盾退回掩體，攻方再補上一槍便能完成貫穿。與之配套的是大矩形盾牌、西班牙式直刃短劍、鎖子甲、開始出現的分節鎧，以及加釘鞋底與皮甲腰帶。攻城靠壕溝、木柵、壘土與突擊；騎兵用輕標槍與長劍，不投重標槍。塞爾托里烏斯另大量依靠伊比利亞與盧西塔尼亞的輕步兵、騎兵，以及北非運來的糧食維持西班牙戰線。
kitsEn: The pilum on the card is the standard missile of the imperial legions in this war: a wooden shaft carrying an iron shank, with a lead collar at the base of the shank for balance, the whole weapon about two metres long, thrown by the legionary before the lines closed, with an effective range of roughly twenty-five to thirty metres. Both Sulla's army and the Marian imperial infantry used this weapon in 83 BC, and it was exactly the pilum that the Marian reforms had made the standard missile of the legion, replacing the older hasta. The whole design of the pilum is aimed at destroying the shield: the shank is thin and hard, it punctures the shield and then snaps and bends, staying in the wood, so that the man cannot throw the shield away and has to drag the deformed shield back behind cover while the attacker lands a second throw. It works with the large rectangular scutum, the Spanish-pattern straight-bladed gladius, chain mail, the first segmented plate corslets, and hobnailed sandals with a leather belt. Siege work was done with ditches, palisades, earth ramps and assault; the cavalry used light javelins and the spatha, never the heavy pilum. Sertorius relied instead on Iberian and Lusitanian light infantry and cavalry, and on grain shipped from North Africa, to keep his Spanish line supplied.
tactics: 蘇拉在意大利的戰法可歸納為三個動作：夜行軍逼近、夜襲奪門、快速打擊各個擊破。前83年十月，他率軍夜抵羅馬城東，黎明前強攻埃斯奎利納高地的城防缺口，梯盾並進，城破後士兵在街巷中與守備雜兵逐屋爭奪，守軍根本來不及集結。前83年的科利納門之役是另一種打法：蘇拉派護民官自行召集的隊伍在夜裡集結，選定城北守備薄弱的一處城門猛攻，把辛納與肯索里努斯的聯軍擠壓在門洞之外，敵軍隨即潰散。前82年對龐貝與諾拉的戰事裡，蘇拉以工程手段圍城，卻在營中遭遇自己薩姆尼特與坎帕尼亞士兵的兵變；他以一次對敵營的夜襲摧毀叛軍，用折損約兩千人的代價換回軍紀，此後再無人敢抗命。塞爾托里烏斯在西班牙走另一條路：不求正面決戰，而是控制河道與渡口，誘敵離開基地，以游擊與斷糧拖住對手，於貝提斯河一役等蘇拉派主將渡河後才以伏兵殲滅其前隊，殘部在缺糧與缺援中崩潰。海上由蘇拉與龐培兩家的船隊維持沿海補給，塞爾托里烏斯則以盧西塔尼亞港口維持自己的航線。
tacticsEn: Sulla's method in Italy comes down to three movements: approach by night march, storm a gate at night, break each enemy in turn. In October 83 BC he brought the army to the east of Rome under cover of darkness and assaulted the breach in the Esquiline defences before dawn, ladders and shields side by side, and once the city fell the soldiers fought house by house through the streets against a scratch garrison that never had time to assemble. The battle of the Colline Gate in 83 BC was a different pattern: a force raised by the Sullan tribunes assembled at night, chose the least defended gate on the north side of the city and hit it hard, squeezing the allied armies of Cinna and Censorinus into the gateway; the enemy broke at once. In the campaigning against Pompeii and Nola in 82 BC Sulla used engineering works to blockade the town, and then faced a mutiny of his own Samnite and Campanian soldiers inside his own camp; he destroyed the mutineers in a night attack on the enemy camp, paying about two thousand men to restore discipline, and after that no one dared resist him again. Sertorius took a different road in Spain: he avoided pitched battle, held the rivers and the fords, lured the enemy away from its bases, and wore it down with raids and by cutting its supplies, striking at the Guadalquivir only after the Sullan commander had crossed, ambushing the vanguard and leaving the survivors to collapse from hunger and lack of relief. At sea, the fleets of Sulla's and Pompeius' houses kept the coastal supply lines running, while Sertorius maintained his own route through the ports of Lusitania.
data: 可核對的數字有限，須分辨估算與史料。時間跨度是前83年至前82年，主戰約兩年，西班牙戰線另延續到前72年。蘇拉自東方帶回的軍隊為六個帝國軍團，按共和國末期一個軍團約四千八百人的常規編制推算，全軍一萬五千人上下，古代作家則多以數萬形容其總兵力。塞爾托里烏斯在盧西塔尼亞的核心是約三千名曾在馬略麾下服役的羅馬老兵，另有大量伊比利亞與盧西塔尼亞步兵、騎兵相隨。蘇拉在兵變之夜突擊敵營，自述折損約兩千人，其中叛兵大半被當場格殺。科利納門與薩爾諾河兩役的雙方損耗，古今記載都沒有可信的數目。清除階段最為混亂：古代作家的數字彼此矛盾，有的說公布的清除名單只有數百人，有的說被處決者達數千乃至九千；米尼亞諾湖畔約六千名薩姆尼特戰俘被集體屠殺。數字本身的落差，說明這場戰爭的記錄從頭到尾由勝者一方壟斷。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are limited, and estimates have to be separated from what the sources actually say. The span is 83 to 82 BC, about two years of main war, with the Spanish theatre running on to 72 BC. The army Sulla brought back from the east was six legions; on the conventional late-Republican establishment of about 4,800 men a legion that is roughly fifteen thousand men in all, while the ancient writers usually talk of tens of thousands for his total force. The core of Sertorius in Lusitania was about three thousand Roman soldiers who had served under Marius, with large numbers of Iberian and Lusitanian infantry and cavalry alongside them. Sulla counted about two thousand men lost in the night attack on the enemy camp that broke the mutiny, most of the mutineers being killed on the spot. For the losses on both sides at the Colline Gate and at the Sarno there is no credible figure in any ancient or modern account. The proscription phase is the most tangled of all: the ancient figures contradict one another, some writers putting the published list at only a few hundred names, others reckoning the dead in the thousands or even nine thousand, and about six thousand Samnite prisoners were killed in one mass execution at the Lake of Lucrine near Mignano. The divergence in the numbers itself shows that the record of this war was controlled throughout by the winning side.
cause: 起戰的根由不在前83年，而在前88年蘇拉第一次以軍隊進攻羅馬之後留下的一連串未解難題：馬里安黨的土地、馬里安老兵的分田要求、平民派政客的護民官式主張，都被蘇拉在東方勝回之後用軍事實力壓了回去。前84年蘇拉與辛納所定的個人和約只是停火，瓜分土地的議題始終沒有落地。前83年蘇拉回國當選執政官，主持了一場在軍刀下進行的選舉，並在元老院安插大量新血；蘇拉派護民官迪迪烏斯與布魯圖斯隨即提出更進取的土地與司法法案，揚言把蘇拉清算時被沒收的產業歸還馬里安派，並追討前88年那次清洗的受害者。這等於要推翻蘇拉用血換來的整個安排，辛納與肯索里努斯表明不肯接受，兩派遂各自徵召武裝，內戰在羅馬城外爆開。西班牙的塞爾托里烏斯不肯放下武器，則讓同一場火在伊比利亞半島再燒十年。
causeEn: The quarrel did not start in 83 BC, but in the succession of unresolved problems left behind after Sulla first marched on Rome with an army in 88 BC: the Marian lands, the land demands of Marian veterans and the tribunician politics of the popular party had all been put down by force once Sulla came back victorious from the east. The personal peace Sulla struck with Cinna in 84 BC was only a ceasefire; the question of how to divide the land never got settled. In 83 BC Sulla came home, was elected consul, ran an election under the edge of the sword and filled the senate with new blood; the Sullan tribunes Didius and Brutes immediately brought forward a more aggressive agrarian and judicial programme, announcing that the property confiscated in Sulla's proscriptions would be returned to the Marian party and that the victims of the purge of 88 BC would be given redress. That was a direct repudiation of the whole arrangement Sulla had bought with blood, and Cinna and Censorinus refused to accept it; both sides called in arms and civil war broke out in front of Rome. In Spain Sertorius would not put down his weapons, and the same fire burned on in Iberia for another ten years.
impact: 這場內戰把羅馬共和國的結構改寫了。蘇拉於前82年奪取羅馬、成為獨裁官，開元老院清冊、沒收財產、處死反對者，這是羅馬史上第一次以正式名冊進行的系統性政治清洗，此後的每一次政變都有人在模仿它的形式。制度上，元老院被大量新成員填滿，護民官的權力被削到只剩空殼，執政官任期內不再享有指揮軍隊的權，軍隊的效忠對象也從國家轉為指揮者本人，蘇拉本人就不止一次帶兵進攻自己的祖國，凱撒後來所做的，不過是把這條路走到底。前84年蘇拉與米特里達梯六世簽訂的和約逼本都軍隊交出艦隊，東方的威脅暫時解除；但塞爾托里烏斯在西班牙自立，前72年他被自己人刺殺時，馬里安派殘部仍在伊比利亞活動，說明蘇拉在意大利的勝利並未終結派系鬥爭，只是把它推遠。戰爭對意大利中部與坎帕尼亞的農業是長期破壞，被擄掠與焚毀的土地荒蕪多年，退伍軍人安置又成了新的政治炸藥。
impactEn: This civil war rewrote the structure of the Roman Republic. In 82 BC Sulla seized Rome and became dictator, opening lists of the senate, confiscating property and executing his enemies: the first systematic political purge in Roman history to be carried out against a published roll, a form later copied by every coup that followed. Institutionally the senate was swollen with new members, the tribunes were reduced to an empty shell, consuls no longer commanded armies in office, and the army's loyalty shifted from the state to the commander in person, Sulla himself having marched on his own country more than once, and what Caesar did later was simply to follow that road to the end. The peace Sulla imposed on Mithridates VI in 84 BC forced the Pontic fleet to be handed over and removed the immediate threat from the east; yet Sertorius had set up an independent state in Spain, and when he was killed by his own men in 72 BC Marian remnants were still active in Iberia, which shows that Sulla's victory in Italy never closed the factional question, only pushed it further away. For the agriculture of central Italy and Campania the war meant long destruction: land that had been plundered and burnt lay fallow for years, and the settlement of the veterans became the next political explosive.
result: 就意大利本土而言，結果是蘇拉派的完勝：辛納與肯索里努斯在戰敗後相繼被自己人殺死，龐培·斯特拉波在薩爾諾河被斬，軍隊與元老院盡入蘇拉之手；前82年他以獨裁官身份主持清算並重新分配共和國的權力，坎帕尼亞的莊園與薩姆尼特武裝被系統性解除，羅馬城內則以名冊與封條維持表面秩序。西班牙是唯一的例外：塞爾托里烏斯的政權在盧西塔尼亞與西班牙東部存活下來，直到前72年他被自己人刺殺，這場內戰的派系問題並未真正結束，只是轉移到更遠的地方。戰利品的分配同樣改變了社會：從意大利各城掠來的財物按軍功分給士兵，戰俘被賣到各地，羅馬的商業秩序在這兩年裡換了一副面孔。整場戰爭真正的收尾不在任何一場會戰，而在蘇拉於前81年頒布的蘇拉和約與前79年他自願卸任：羅馬從此明白，只要有人握著兵權，執政官、護民官與元老院都護不住任何人，這才是蘇拉內戰最貴重的教訓。
resultEn: In Italy itself the result was a complete Sullan victory: Cinna and Censorinus were killed by their own men after the defeat, Pompeius Strabo was cut down at the Sarno, and the army and the senate ended up in Sulla's hands; in 82 BC he presided over the purge as dictator and reallocated the powers of the republic, the estates of Campania and the Samnite armed bands were systematically broken up, and order in the city of Rome was kept on paper by lists and seals. Spain was the single exception: Sertorius' regime survived in Lusitania and in the east of Spain until his own men killed him in 72 BC, so the factional question of the war was never really settled, only moved somewhere else. The distribution of the spoils changed society too: property taken from the cities of Italy was divided among the soldiers by merit, prisoners of war were sold in every direction, and the commercial order of Rome came out of those two years wearing a different face. The real ending of the whole war lay in no battle at all, but in the Sullan settlement proclaimed in 81 BC and in Sulla's voluntary resignation in 79: Rome had learned that as long as one man holds the troops, consuls, tribunes and senators can protect nobody, and that is the most expensive lesson of the Sullan civil war.
